scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.db:check: node --env-file=.env -e "import pg from 'pg'; const { Pool } = pg; const url = process.env.DATABASE_URL || ''; const shouldUseSsl = /neon\.tech|sslmode=require/i.test(url) || !url.includes('localhost'); const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: url, ssl: shouldUseSsl ? { rejectUnauthorized: false } : undefined }); pool.query('SELECT 1 AS ok').then(({ rows }) => { console.log('DB_OK', rows[0].ok); }).catch((error) => { console.error('DB_CHECK_FAILED'); console.error(error.message); process.exit(1); }).finally(() => pool.end());"
